title: Twin check started: 1410 sessions have two folders

owner_note.text: The daily check found 1410 sessions held by more than one folder, left from before the one finder (2026-11-01). From tomorrow it reports only new ones. Fold these: node Server/SessionConsolidate.mjs --all --apply --manifest <file>.
